seo_title: Bezier: Framer Template Design | The Brandle
summary: A Framer template for design studios, with a 3D Bezier curve visitors can bend.

brief.label: Framer template, design studios
brief.heading: The idea
paras: Most studio templates look like everyone else's. Bezier looks like the design tool clients never get to see: selection boxes, named cursors and artboards on a dark canvas.
It is a Framer template for design studios and freelancers who sell brand, web and product design on a monthly plan.

answer.label: Launched 2026
answer.heading: What's inside
paras: The hero is a glossy 3D curve. It draws itself in, leans toward the cursor and bends when you drag its handles. People do drag the handles. We checked, repeatedly, instead of working.
Eight pages and three CMS collections: projects, journal and testimonials. Work cards stack and recede as you scroll, and the studio statement fills in word by word.
It is on the Framer Marketplace, written for a real studio, so you swap in your name, your work and your prices.
